notes.title: Pre-Ignition Feature and Balance patch
notes.notes:
Hey Paizanos, we're taking the opportunity to test out some stuff while Ignition is finishing up. 

Included in the patch are sevral bugfixes, new features (mostly PC oriented) and some balance tweaks. See the full details over at the patch notes thread.

Ignition's almost out of the oven, don't you worry! We'll be showin a little somthin somthin at an upcoming event that may or may not be at Tokyo.

notes.title: Devil Engine will release Febuary 21st!
notes.notes:
Been a bit of a long 2018 winter hasn't it?

Devil Engine will finally be launching later this month, on the 21st!
Leading up to release we'll be showing off some more footage and development tidbits on Twitter, so check us out over there.

According to Steam, the game will be released at 6am PST on the 21st, so plan accordingly!
